answer: Decay standing per idle epoch, slash it on a failed audit, and score the task rather than the address that filed it. Edge case: an identity that moves hosts mid-epoch keeps its task credit but loses the uptime bonus, so a wander between providers costs a week of decay. A writer documenting a marble seam, a pulse reading and a wander route earns per task. A farm that rotates addresses still loses the decay and the slash on every seat.
